batches.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Transparent game sprite sheet of Hotdog, using the supplied image as the exact character reference. Preserve this exact small fluffy fantasy pet identity (Hotdog is not food): compact low-bodied round creature with a rainbow striped coat, huge upright round gray ears with dark navy rims, deep navy face mask, large amber-brown eyes, red heart on forehead, tall red-orange-yellow flame-shaped tuft, white chest, short navy paws and long matching rainbow tail. Exactly four short animal legs and paws, no clothing, no human hands/fingers, no extra arms. For gripping poses he may briefly rear on his hind paws and bring both tiny front paws together; retain round animal body and paw shapes. Exactly EIGHT full-body poses, four columns and two rows, read left to right then next row. Consistent head/ear size and body proportions, clean bold navy outlines and soft cel shading matching the reference, three-quarter view facing RIGHT, generous transparent gutters; ears, tuft, tail and all paws fully inside every cell. ROW 1: 1 tug-of-war ready: hind paws planted, body leaning BACK left, both tiny front paws held together reaching forward-right at chest height to grip an invisible rope, cheerful determined face; 2 tug heave: lean farther back, knees bent, same forward empty two-paw grip, joyful exertion; 3 fishing reel ready: reared on hind paws, leaning back slightly, near front paw reaching forward-right at chest height as if gripping an invisible rod, other paw beside it ready to crank, focused happy gaze right; 4 fishing reel crank: same hind-paw stance and forward grip, other front paw moved inward/down to crank an invisible reel, bright grin. ROW 2: 5 overhead swing windup: reared with hind legs braced, both tiny front paws together raised above the right shoulder, empty grip, gleeful face; 6 swing followthrough: both front paws moved forward-right and upward above the face, finishing a gentle overhead strike, cheerful grin; 7 putting ready: side-on facing right, on all four short paws, knees softly bent, both front paws together low and forward-right as if holding an invisible putter, looking down-right; 8 putting followthrough: same low four-paw stance, front paws extended slightly forward-right after a gentle putt, looking up-right hopefully. No rope, rod, fishing line, bat, putter, balls, scenery, ground, shadows, text, labels or motion effects. True transparent background.
